# Logic Works

> Logic Works is a digital agency in Dubai, UAE with 5+ years in the UAE
> market and 150+ projects delivered. We build mobile apps, high-converting
> websites, and AI-powered marketing systems (SEO, PPC, social media) for
> ambitious GCC brands across the Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait,
> Oman, and Bahrain.
